exact_copy_resolution: For an original fdsa-control/ path, prepend each exact_copy_root and slash; one exact physical owner exists unless listed under exceptions. Physical hashes belong to the package payload manifest.
shared_source_resolution: Restore common Git source; git cat-file blob <git_blob>.
shared_tooling_resolution: Resolve shared_path under common tooling area.
alias_resolution: Recursively resolve canonical_original_path; alias_range selects bytes[offset:offset+length]. Verify original_bytes and original_sha256.

exceptions.object_transport: Original FDSA pack absorbed into the complete common Git store.
